# HL7 `FHIR/fhir-test-cases` R4 Validation Vectors Attribution

The positive and negative FHIR R4 specimen vectors in `positive/` and `negative/`
(`bundle-with-no-type.json` and canonical `r4/examples/*.json` specimens) are vendored
from the official HL7 `FHIR/fhir-test-cases` repository
(`https://github.com/FHIR/fhir-test-cases/tree/master/r4`), distributed under the
Apache License, Version 2.0 (see [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt)).
